Preserve this complete grey outfit and subdued expression. No hat, cigarette, weapon, keyring, tag, strap or lettering.

Jump: face SCREEN-RIGHT, both feet off the ground with knees bent, arms raised for balance; a readable airborne silhouette. All limbs and costume details fit inside the image with ample space.

Render ONE complete polished hand-drawn 2D cel-shaded fighting-game sprite with clean dark outlines and clear flat colour regions. Entire figure including every eye, hat tip, feather tip, finger and both feet is fully inside generous transparent safety margins. True transparent RGBA background. No floor, cast shadow, glow, background, frame, text, watermark, duplicate body, speed lines or motion blur. Anatomical consistency is mandatory: one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Native facing must be SCREEN-RIGHT; do not mirror anatomical costume details.
